description: December 10 birthday meaning: Sagittarius decan 2, birthday number 1, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, a December 10 birthday falls in Sagittarius, in the second decan, with Jupiter as the sign's ruler and Mars as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 1. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Sagittarius is mutable and fire.

sections.heading: Personality of a December 10 birthday
paragraphs: Ten reduces to 1, and December 10 shows that number's self-reliance clearly. With the Sun at roughly eighteen degrees of Sagittarius, the Mars-sub-ruled decan adds boldness and urgency. The blend is often read as a trailblazer, impatient with hesitation, who prefers to learn by doing and would rather apologise later than wait for perfect conditions.

By noon UTC on December 10, the Sun has normally reached roughly 18° of Sagittarius. That places the date in the Sagittarius decan that astrologers give to Mars, the second of three. Mars, ruler of Aries, acts as sub-ruler for the middle of Sagittarius, roughly December 2 to December 11. The sign's love of freedom picks up a sharper, more competitive edge. Early-December birthdays are frequently linked with bold, energetic people who are quick to champion a cause, whether on a playing field, in a debate or on the road. Their honesty may be direct enough to startle. Mars brings drive and courage, along with impatience when life moves slowly. Channelled well, this mix of vision and nerve makes for a natural pioneer, someone willing to test an idea in the real world.

sections.heading: Numerology of the December 10 birthday
paragraphs: A birthday on the 10th is a compound: 1 + 0 = 1. In Pythagorean numerology this is read as a 1 with a 0 attached, and the 0 is often described as amplifying whatever stands beside it. So the 10th carries the independence and initiative of the 1, with an added sense of potential and of cycles completing and restarting. People born on this day are frequently portrayed as self-reliant and adaptable, able to begin again after setbacks. The day number is secondary to the Life Path, but here it often shows as a quiet, practical resilience.

Because the year enters the Life Path calculation, the same December 10 birthday leads to different paths across generations, among them 4 for 1980, 5 for 1990, 6 for 2000 and 7 for 2010. Some birth years on this date reach the master number 11. The Life Path calculator does the reduction for any year.

sections.heading: December 10 in context: the season, Chinese zodiac and famous birthdays
paragraphs: December birthdays arrive at the start of northern winter, around the shortest days and the year's festivities, and at the start of summer in the southern hemisphere. Sagittarius holds most of the month, with Capricorn beginning around December 21 or 22. In numerology December is month 12, which reduces to 3: expression and sociability, built from the 1 and 2 of initiative and partnership. December 10 is the 344th day of the year (345th in a leap year). In most years Capricorn season is under way by December 22, 12 days after this birthday.

Chinese astrology is straightforward for a December 10 birthday: the new year began weeks earlier, so the birth year's own animal applies. December 10 is also the birthday of Emily Dickinson (1830), Ada Lovelace (1815) and Nelly Sachs (1891).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is December 10?
faq.answer: December 10 is Sagittarius in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the second decan of Sagittarius, which tradition links with Mars.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on December 10?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On December 10 the Life Path is 11 in 1960, 3 in 1970, 4 in 1980, 5 in 1990, 6 in 2000, 7 in 2010 and 8 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 1 for everyone born on the 10th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on December 10?
faq.answer: By December 10 the Chinese new year is well under way, which means the animal and element are those of the calendar birth year.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on December 10?
faq.answer: Among the best-known people with a December 10 birthday are Emily Dickinson (1830), Ada Lovelace (1815) and Nelly Sachs (1891). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
